title: Brush, Splash & Sleep! 🪥🐱 Max's Happy Songs for Kids

songs.name: BRUSH, BRUSH, BRUSH!
chorus: all
Brush, brush, brush! Up and down we go!
max
Little teeth so shiny, white as snow!
all
Brush, brush, brush! Round and round and round!
mouse
Squeaky clean, the cleanest teeth in town!
verses: Good morning, sun! I'm up out of bed!
First, brush your teeth, sleepy head!
A tiny bit of paste, just a pea!
Hey, wait for me! Brush with me!
Brush the front teeth, one, two, three!
Brush the back teeth, tweet tweet tee!
Don't forget the top and the bottom too!
Good job, Max! I'm proud of you!
Now we spit and rinse, splash, splash, splash!
Look at that smile, it's a flash!
Twice a day, morning and night!
Then our smiles are sparkly bright!

songs.name: YUMMY VEGGIES!
chorus: all
Crunch, crunch, munch, munch, yummy veggies!
max
Green and orange, red and yellow too!
all
Crunch, crunch, munch, munch, yummy veggies!
grandma
Veggies make you big and strong, it's true!
verses: Let's pick a carrot from the garden bed!
Pull, pull, pull! Oh, I fell on my head!
Woof! Is it a bone? Can I chew?
No, silly Dog, it's a carrot for you!
Little green peas in a little green pod!
Tweet! I see one! Can I have a nod?
One for you, and one for me!
And ten for me! Yum, yum, yummy!
I tried broccoli, a tiny tree!
Now I like it! Try it with me!

songs.name: LET'S PLAY IN THE PARK!
chorus: all
Let's play, play, play in the park today!
max
Run and jump and spin around!
all
Let's play, play, play, hip hip hooray!
dog
Then we all fall down on the ground!
verses: I've got my ball! Who wants to play?
Me! Me! Throw it far away!
Up in the sky, I see it go!
Look out, Max! It's coming low!
Hop like a bunny, one, two, three!
Hop, hop, hop! Can you hop like me?
Wag your tail, wiggle, wiggle, wag!
Flap your wings like a flying flag!
Now we take turns, that's the rule!
Sharing the ball is super cool!
Your turn, my turn, one by one!
Playing together is the most fun!

songs.name: SANDCASTLE SONG!
chorus: all
Scoop, pat, pat! Build it tall and wide!
max
A sandy castle by the sea side!
all
Scoop, pat, pat! Make the tower high!
mouse
Way, way up, up to the sky!
verses: Bucket and spade, here we go!
Fill it up with sand, nice and slow!
Flip it over, give it a tap!
Look! A tower! Clap, clap, clap!
Shells for the windows, one, two, three!
A little red flag, just for me!
I'll dig a moat, dig, dig, dig!
Not too big, Dog! Not too big!
Here comes a wave! Splish, splash, whoosh!
Our castle melted! Mush, mush, mush!
Don't be sad, we'll build some more!

songs.name: GOODNIGHT, MAX!
chorus: grandma
Goodnight, Max, close your sleepy eyes.
mouse
Stars are shining in the sky.
grandma
Goodnight, Max, dream of something sweet.
all
Tomorrow there's a brand new day to meet.
verses: Pajamas on, a warm bath done.
We had so much fun in the sun.
Yawn! My paws are tired too.
Can I have a story? Just a new one, two?
Once upon a time, a little cat.
Was it me? With a red scarf like that?
Yes, it was you, so brave and kind.
The very best friend we could ever find.
Goodnight, Max, I'll sleep like a log.
